label: 維爾冬男性偏文 · 單手盾
prompt: Create a sprite sheet as an ordinary fully opaque RGB image on solid hot pink background. Do not cut out the background, do not use transparency or alpha. 6 columns by 6 rows equal cells. 36 separate full body hand-painted RPG sprites, same scale, generous pink margins separating every pose. Adult proportions, detailed small sprites, right-facing 3/4 side view. Character: slender adult northern man with swept ash-blond hair, neat braid and no beard, deep blue long wool coat, ivory fur collar, bronze knotwork clasps, rune-carved belt and fitted brown boots. Holds one small round wooden-and-bronze shield strapped to LEFT forearm, right hand empty, no sword or other weapon. Rows: 1 idle breathing, 2 brace the round shield close to torso then a forceful forward shield bash to RIGHT and recoil, right hand stays empty, 3 hit recoil, 4 shield guard, 5 low sidestep dodge, 6 collapse to ground. Exactly six poses per row. No floor, shadows, text, borders, labels. Attack contained entirely in row 2. OPAQUE #FF00FF RGB background.
